caption:
When one cool glance can sink your whole day — whose approval are you standing on? (1 Timothy 1:1 devotional)

Paul doesn't open his letter with achievements. He opens with authority: an apostle *by the commandment of God.* A good servant stands not in a place he built, but in a place the King's command established.

Only the person who stands under the King's command is freed from anxiously reading the room.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
